context.purpose: Construct dimensioned mounting plates and annular spacers as independently checked faceted solids.
context.assumptions: Explicit millimetres, stable OpenSCAD 2021.01, XY contours extruded vertically, no imported code.
context.constraints: 0.5–200 mm dimensions, height<=100 mm, translation ±100 mm, <=16 separated interior holes,16–256 segments divisible by4.
context.inspection: Independent binary STL parsing checks cross-sections, boundary facets, normals, manifold topology, bounds and faceted volume; fresh native STL reopen.
context.recovery: INVALID_CAD_CLEARANCE requires interior separated holes or positive wall; INVALID_CAD_RESOLUTION needs multiple of4. Inspect retained logs for native/geometry failure.

workflow.scope: Verified summary value handoffs, unit-explicit STL publications, reuse and invalidation.

composition.scope: Finite dimensions/segment studies resolve before native execution.

lifecycle.timeout: Total wall deadline shared across three native stages;2 GiB address space,4 MiB output and60s CPU per process.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned process-tree cancellation and prepublication check.
lifecycle.logs: Authored/plan/source/launchers and version/construct/reopen stdout/stderr, submissions and consumed-input bindings.
lifecycle.verification: Independent analytic polygon extrusion boundary, normal/topology/bounds/volume checks; native fresh import/reexport; literal known fixtures and refreshed-hash adversaries.

losses: STL contains no unit metadata or analytic curves; explicit consumer mm convention required.
Circular boundaries are inscribed regular polygons; across-flats bore smaller than nominal.
data.scope: Bounded dimensioned plate/spacer only; no manufacturing suitability certification.

losses: Geometry verification only; no strength/material analysis.

inspection.scope: Dimensioned volume/bounds/topology summary and native logs.
inspection.limits: No live native geometry editing; inspect STL separately if desired.

authoring.reuse: Edit dimensions,holes,resolution ortranslation; shared plan resolves studies and reuse follows verified inputs.
